# Agua Instruments

> Agua Instruments supplies certified instrumentation and analyzers for environmental monitoring — water & wastewater quality, ambient air quality, continuous emission (stack/CEMS), industrial gas detection, and weather monitoring — serving industries, municipalities, and regulatory-compliance projects across India, the UAE, and export markets.

## Products & Monitoring Systems

- [Water Quality Monitoring System](https://www.aguainstruments.com/water-quality-monitoring-system.html): Online analyzers for STP/ETP/CETP and effluent (OCEMS) monitoring
- [Air Quality Monitoring System](https://www.aguainstruments.com/air-quality-monitoring-system.html): CAAQMS and indoor air quality monitors
- [Emission Monitoring System](https://www.aguainstruments.com/emission-monitoring-system.html): Continuous Emission Monitoring Systems (CEMS) for stack emissions
- [Gas Monitoring System](https://www.aguainstruments.com/gas-monitoring-system.html): Fixed and portable toxic/combustible gas detection
- [Weather Monitoring System](https://www.aguainstruments.com/weather-monitoring-system.html): Automatic weather stations and agromet systems
- [Gas Analyzer](https://www.aguainstruments.com/gas-analyzer.html): Gas analyzer product line
- [Water Analyzer](https://www.aguainstruments.com/water-analyzer.html): Water quality analyzer product line
- [Ambient Air Quality](https://www.aguainstruments.com/ambient-air-quality.html): Ambient air quality analyzer product line
- [Dust Analyzer](https://www.aguainstruments.com/dust-analyzer.html): Particulate matter and dust monitoring instruments
- [Auto Sampler](https://www.aguainstruments.com/auto-sampler.html): Automatic water/wastewater sampling equipment
- [Pharma TOC](https://www.aguainstruments.com/pharma-toc.html): Total Organic Carbon analyzers for pharmaceutical applications
